# #3989 — Python Worker generated bytecode cache exclusion trial (2026-10-10 KST)

## Official contract
Cloudflare Wrangler's Python Workers configuration bundles `python_modules`; its default exclude list contains `**/*.pyc`, and Cloudflare documents an optional `[python_modules] exclude = ["**/*.pyc", "**/__pycache__"]` to avoid generated `__pycache__` trees. Source: https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/wrangler/configuration/#python-workers

## Exact scope
Only the four existing real Workerd/Pyodide **probe-generated** `.runtime-*.toml` configuration snippets gain this documented exclusion. The production `apps/padiem-chat/wrangler.toml`, Python Worker code, package locks, `pywrangler sync --force`, pinned `wrangler@4.130.0`, Workerd dev runtime, ports, independent persistence/SQLite roots, 90 readiness attempts, all original HTTP assertions and all four real Worker scripts are **unchanged**. No non-bytecode Python module is filtered. The B62 runner continues four-way parallel on its existing single Linux runner, with a fail-closed aggregator and Worker bundle dry-run.

The offline source contract asserts identical `[python_modules]` tables across the four source-generated configs, preserves `**/*.pyc` in the overridden default, retains `__pycache__` exclusion and all original probe gate markers. Do not use this config to exclude `padiem_ai_core`, `kagent` or other genuine runtime dependencies.

## Performance acceptance
Baseline real Linux [#4130 PR head #38040385829](https://github.com/skerishKang/ai-revenue-lab/actions/runs/38040385829): four-worker job **141s**, Workerd launch-to-`/ready` ~89–92s, HTTP <1s. Other unmodified `main` runs varied substantially, so no causal/saved-runner-minute claim on one PR run. Prior rejected trials: [#4126 npm npx cache](https://github.com/skerishKang/ai-revenue-lab/pull/4126), [#4133 two-by-two waves](https://github.com/skerishKang/ai-revenue-lab/pull/4133), [#4136 three-plus-one waves](https://github.com/skerishKang/ai-revenue-lab/pull/4136).

- Run exact-head Linux CI with mandatory B62 Chat/Core, all four *real* Workerd/Pyodide probes (4/4 PASS), Worker bundle dry-run, B14 classifier/multimodal, browser planner, Operations Policy, GitGuardian, final `b62-test`.
- Read four current `B62_WORKER_PHASE_*` phase stamps from raw Worker logs and actual Worker job duration. If there is a substantial improvement, rerun **only Worker job** at the same exact head once; no entire workflow redispatch.
- Also inspect the actual vendored `python_modules` tree for `__pycache__` existence: if absent there is no reason to keep a no-op config. Only merge if checks PASS **and repeatable meaningful speed gain** without weakened tests. Otherwise close this PR unmerged and retain merged phase telemetry.

No extra CI runner, workflow dispatch, Production deploy, Secrets changes, provider paid calls or dependency updates. Keep #3989 OPEN.
